name: shieldz-swap
description: Non-custodial cross-chain swaps: live route quotes and deposit-address swaps on 40+ chains. No API key.
long_description: Compare live cross-chain swap routes across NEAR Intents, Chainflip, Relay, MAYAChain, BOB Gateway and Garden, create a swap that returns a one-time deposit address, and track it to payout. Covers BTC, ETH, SOL, ZEC, USDC, USDT and 340+ assets on 40+ chains. Non-custodial: the user sends funds from their own wallet and the server never holds keys. No account, no KYC, flat 0.15% fee included in quotes.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Search 340+ routable assets on 40+ chains and get their exact ids.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Live cross-chain quote racing NEAR Intents, Chainflip, Relay, MAYAChain, BOB Gateway and Garden.

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Open a non-custodial swap and get a one-time deposit address.

tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description: Check a swap: pending, processing, success, refunded, expired, with tx links.

tools.name: report_deposit
tools.description: Report the deposit tx hash so the swap is detected faster.
